result.summary: The page is mostly well-structured, but there is one minor layout issue related to content overlap at the bottom of the visible area.

issues.description: The '-20%' discount tag on the pizza image at the bottom is partially cut off/overlapping the edge of the image container, making it look slightly misaligned.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the padding or margins of the discount tag within its parent container to ensure it is fully visible and properly spaced from the image edge.
